hypothesis: Lack of a supported swing objective inhibits useful forward gait discovery
single_changed_variable: weight of contact/airtime/clearance/progress objective: off vs fixed 1.5
initial: a402 trained residual and critic weights; fresh Adam/RNG/episodes
candidate_selection: Only fixed final endpoint, no checkpoint selection
success_gate: 32/32 native courses, no falls, sustained long forward >=0.35 m/s; paired ordinary retains >=95%; geometric step metrics reported separately, no flight requirement
ablation_signal: protected must improve >=5% sustained long speed without new failed cases, or strictly improve success without speed regression versus same-seed all-replay control
swing_definition: Single stance foot, other foot airborne 0.125<t<0.300s and lowest foot hull >5mm, tilt<.35rad and height>.08m, multiplied by clamp(actual_forward/requested_forward,0,1), sprint only. Both arms measure identical sensor data.
retracted_hypothesis: Actual a402 teacher excludes all sprint commands; general sampler description was misleading. No full scope training was launched. 64env/5iter scope smoke used an older replay and is excluded.
swing_weight_rationale: Upstream airtime/linear tracking weights 3/2; local linear maximum 1, so 1.5 preserves this nominal ratio only. Other rewards and gates differ; not full recipe equivalence.
